title: Erdős #25: Logarithmic Density of Residue-Avoiding Sets
description: Infrastructure for Erdős Problem #25: must the logarithmic density of residue-avoiding sets always exist? Formalizes logarithmic density (upper, lower, and exact), the residue-avoiding set construction, and proves basic properties. Related to the Davenport-Erdős theorem on log density of multiples. 3 axioms for density limit results. 25 theorems.

overview.historicalContext: Erdős #25 asks whether log density always exists for residue-avoiding sets.
overview.problemStatement: Define logarithmic density and residue-avoiding sets; prove basic properties; state the open question.
overview.proofStrategy: Define log density as lim of (1/log N) Σ_{n≤N, n∈A} 1/n; prove upper/lower density properties.
